analyst_view.overall: Celta (12th) lost 1-2 at home to Union Saint-Gilloise in the Europa League on Thursday, so they have had less rest than Levante (18th). Claudio Giráldez has been criticised and is without Starfelt, Álvaro Núñez, El-Abdellaoui, Miguel Román and Borja Iglesias. Levante's Luis Castro has only Manu Sánchez definitely out, with Bardeli fit for limited minutes. Spanish football is also mourning Tenerife's Jesús de Miguel; the players' union (AFE) asked for this round to be postponed, but so far only Granada-Tenerife has been called off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Celta are without their main striker Borja Iglesias and are tired after Thursday, which lowers their threat. Levante's defence has been leaky, though, and Levante won both of the last two meetings at Balaídos (2-1 and 3-2). These factors roughly cancel out.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners. Celta usually have most of the ball at home, but a tired, rotated side and the loss of creative midfielder Miguel Román may cut their pressure. We found nothing that clearly moves this figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Levante are in the bottom three and will need to fight, while Celta are under pressure, but neither side has a suspension problem and no referee had been named when we looked. We stay with the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots. Celta played a full Europa League game on Thursday and are missing Borja Iglesias and Miguel Román, two of their main attacking outlets, and Giráldez is expected to rotate. That points to slightly fewer shots than the site expects.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. Without Borja Iglesias, Celta's final-third quality drops, and Levante's Thiago Fernández is creating chances but has yet to score this season. We lean a little under the site's number.
